prompt: Go through all the ready-for-spec issues in replay, analyze them for dependencies, and spec each one. Use full for anything that looks architecturally complex, lite for normal features, quick for small stuff. Just specs for now, no implementation.

assertions.text: Uses gh issue list with label filter to discover issues
Checks for existing specs in progress before processing
Analyzes dependencies between issues (explicit refs and implicit code overlap)
Presents issues in wave-based execution plan with parallel grouping
Assigns pipeline modes (full/lite/quick) with reasoning tied to issue complexity
Includes a user confirmation checkpoint before executing
Describes monitoring strategy using acorn status
